assessment_objectives.objective: a formal, documented Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) policy is approved by executive management, or a formally delegated authority, and conveys executive management's intent for Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR).

the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) policy provides organizational direction and states the behaviors expected of personnel and other applicable parties with respect to Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR).

the current version of the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) policy is communicated to, and accessible by, the personnel and other applicable parties who are expected to comply with it.
the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) policy is reviewed at least annually.

the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) policy is updated, as necessary, in response to changes in risks, threats, business practices and/or statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations that affect the organization.
